title: How to implement JSON-LD in your Next.js application

description: Learn how to add JSON-LD to your Next.js application to describe your content to search engines and AI.

is a format for structured data that can be used by search engines and AI to help them understand the structure of the page beyond pure content. For example, you can use it to describe a person, an event, an organization, a movie, a book, a recipe, and many other types of entities.

const jsonLd: WithContext<Product> = {
	'@context': 'https://schema.org',
	'@type': 'Product',
	name: 'Next.js Sticker',
	image: 'https://nextjs.org/imgs/sticker.png',
	description: 'Dynamic at the speed of static.',
}
